Nothing is saved yet. Please confirm these values for the GEMINI hackathon case (Delft, 2027). Values from the brief PDF and the two demand CSVs are set without asking; the lines below are the ones that need your approval.

FROM THE CASE'S ASSUMPTIONS DOCUMENT (knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md):
1. demand.heating.return_temperature = 60 degC | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team | below the fixed 100 degC supply
2. demand.heating.return_pressure = 6 bar | assumptions document, "Team"
3. demand.cooling.return_temperature = 25 degC | design choice, the brief leaves it to the team | above the fixed 20 degC supply
4. demand.cooling.return_pressure = 4 bar | assumptions document, "Team"
5. demand.cooling.indoor_temperature = 26 degC | assumptions document, "Team"
6. demand.cooling.indoor_relative_humidity = 0.5 (50 %) | assumptions document, "Team"
7. demand.cooling.dew_point_margin = 1 K | assumptions document, "Team"
8. site.fluid.sand_concentration = 20 mg/l | assumptions document, "Team"
9. utilities.electricity.co2_intensity = 300 g/kWh | organisers (Discord #technical-q-and-a, 2026-11-04), constant (a simplification of a grid series)
10. utilities.gas.composition (bought grid gas, mole fractions, digits as written) = CH4 0.8249507401227822, C2H6 0.039549858193534584, C3H8 0.012748086337494389, CO2 0.011912342910726407, N2 0.11083897243546233 | assumptions document, "Team"

FROM THE OPEN-METEO SERVER (the site and the 2027 weather you asked for):
11. site.air.temperature = series from delft_air_2027.csv, column temperature_2m_mean, unit °C | open-meteo openmeteo_get_climate, bias-corrected CMIP6 daily PROJECTION (not a measurement), called 2026-11-05T19:00:15Z, lat 52.00667 / lon 4.35556, 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31, 365 daily records
12. site.air.relative_humidity = series from delft_air_2027.csv, column relative_humidity_2m_mean, unit % | same call; gemini converts the %
13. site.air.pressure = {elevation: 4 m} | open-meteo openmeteo_get_elevation, called 2026-11-05T19:00:31Z, same coordinates; gemini derives the ISA pressure from the elevation (no pressure number is invented)
14. Site coordinates: Delft, Netherlands = 52.00667, 4.35556, timezone Europe/Amsterdam | open-meteo openmeteo_search_locations, called 2026-11-05T19:00:03Z (the tool flags it as a low-confidence city match: population 95,060; the coordinates are the town's)

MY ASSUMPTION (no file states it):
15. time_zone of both demand series = Europe/Amsterdam | agent assumption | the CSV dates carry no offset and no file gives a zone; the site is Delft

REQUIREMENTS (8, from the brief p. 2 and the assumptions document's tolerances):
16. production_flow_range: doublet, production_flow, each, running, 50 to 300 m3/h | PDF p. 2 (the 50 and 300 rows merged into one range)
17. brine_cooling_limit: doublet, brine_cooling, each, running, max 40 K | PDF p. 2
18. running_time_limit: doublet, production_flow, duration, running, max 330 d | PDF p. 2 ("330 daily steps", read as a duration per doublet)
19. pump_efficiency: doublet, pump_efficiency, 0.7 to 0.7 (no unit) | PDF p. 2 (70 %)
20. full_reinjection: doublet, reinjection_ratio, each, running, 0.99999 to 1.00001 | PDF p. 2 rule, band from the assumptions document
21. doublet_count: doublet, count, 1 to 3 | PDF p. 2
22. heat_delivered: heating_supply, unmet_share, max 0.01 | assumptions document (1 % tolerance)
23. cold_delivered: cooling_supply, unmet_share, max 0.01 | assumptions document (1 % tolerance)

RULES GEMINI CANNOT EXPRESS (recorded in the case's about, not as requirements): production and injection into the same reservoir; one daily power/energy balance step; the whole system meets demand on all 365 days; the pump-intake limits (free gas ≤ 18.75 %, intake pressure ≥ 5 bar) which the assumptions document marks "only if the design checks it"; the well-depth search range 2000 to 3500 m (a design freedom).

Not set, deliberately: site.reservoir.temperature (gemini derives it from surface temperature, gradient and depth — no measurement exists); utilities.gas.heating_value (gemini computes it from the composition); utilities.electricity.import_limit / export_limit (no grid operator gives one); site.fluid.dissolved_gas.N2 / H2S and utilities.gas.composition.O2 / H2S (no source states them).

Approve all, change some, or stop?

Allow set_case (write)?
